messages:
alex_support: FYI — incoming ticket: user signed up, verified email & phone OTP, added Apple Pay, but welcome credits never appeared. Account ID and events below. 

alex_support: Account: acct_01G8XYZ12345, email: jamie+eu@example.com, region: AT (Austria). User says they saw 'verification successful' messages.

alex_support: Repro steps from customer: 1) signup 2) email verify 3) phone OTP (SMS) 4) add Apple Pay 5) complete 3DS later. No credits.

alex_support: Server log snippet they pasted:
```
event: signup_complete account=acct_01G8XYZ12345 region=AT
event: email_verified account=acct_01G8XYZ12345
event: phone_verified account=acct_01G8XYZ12345 method=sms
event: payment_method_added account=acct_01G8XYZ12345 pm_type=apple_pay bin_country=US
event: payment_3ds result=success
grant_trial_credit(account) => false reason=payment_gate_bin_mismatch
```

alex_support: Looks like payment/bin-country gating kicked in after they added PM, even though email+phone verified first. Customer expected credits immediately after verification. They want manual grant and an explanation.

maya_billing: Thanks — I can manually grant but want to confirm policy. Our flow blocks auto-grant if payment method BIN country != signup region OR if pay method added before all verifications. In this case BIN=US vs region=AT, so gate is expected.

maya_billing: To proceed: need confirmation from customer that the payment method is theirs and not a VPN. Can we confirm IP/behavior? Also check whether they used company VPN at signup.

riley_eng: @alex_support can you paste full header of the signup event (ip, user_agent) so we can check geo mismatch? If we have the original signup IP we can decide if BIN mismatch is false positive.

alex_support: Pasting minimal header from logs (redacted):
```
signup_ip=81.13.45.22 user_agent=Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_4) AppleWebKit
```
(alex_support: IP resolves to Vienna based on quick lookup)

sam_support: Customer confirmed they weren't using VPN and the device was in AT at signup. They said they added an Apple Pay card issued in the US later because they travel.

riley_eng: Ok — two gates collided: region_ok (ip) true, email/phone verified true, but pm_bin != signup_region => payment gating. Current policy is conservative to prevent cross-border trial abuse. We could relax rule for phone-verified users but that needs product sign-off.

maya_billing: I'll do a one-off manual grant once the customer confirms ownership of that card and consents to trial grant. Can you get explicit confirmation?

alex_support: Replied to customer asking for a photo of last 4 digits of the card or a billing email match. Awaiting reply.

ops_bot: FLAGGED: manual_review_required acct_01G8XYZ12345 reason=bin_country_mismatch created_by=policy-enforcer v=2.1

riley_eng: Quick note for follow-up: log key we should surface in Console -> onboarding pipeline: `grant_trial_credit_reason` so support can see which gate blocked it without digging logs. Filing a small ticket.

alex_support: Filing as a follow-up this morning — will request manual grant once customer confirms. @maya_billing can you hold a one-off until I confirm?

maya_billing: Yes hold for my action. Please include the customer confirmation in thread. I'll add the manual grant audit note after. :thumbsup:

sam_support: If customer confirms, can we also document the user-facing wording in the signup flow? They were surprised there was no explanation. Might reduce tickets.

riley_eng: Agree. I'll add a short devtask to show a clearer message: "Trial credits withheld due to payment method country differing from signup region — contact support for review".

alex_support: Thanks all — keeping this thread open. Will update when customer replies with card last4 or billing match.
